summary: Connect a vector-output dense–ReLU layer and all its gradients to an actual TorchLean graph and automatically generated backward.

Verify a separately supplied parallel binary32 implementation with a fixed reduction tree, fresh scratch per round, synchronization and explicit storage and numerical conditions; defer GPU execution and benchmarking.
remaining: Implemented: actual TorchLean matrix graph, generated VJP and derivative identification away from every ReLU kink; balanced-tree arithmetic existence and universal error bounds; bias/ReLU/gate bounds; reusable fetched mixed-thread control, trace-derived repeated-barrier ordering, complete memory projection, single-writer source forcing and a completed admitted two-round publication witness. Missing: the parallel layer program and its completed admitted execution, layer-specific scratch ownership and phase timing, padding and dimension/launch bounds, and stored forward/backward numerical correspondence. The publication witness is not a layer kernel; arithmetic existence is not layer execution existence.

from.quote:
The layer takes an input vector x of length n, a trainable m-by-n weight matrix W,
and a bias vector b of length m. It returns y_i=max(sum_j W_ij*x_j+b_i,0).
Its automatically generated TorchLean backward takes an incoming sensitivity
vector d of length m. With g_i=d_i on a positive affine value and zero otherwise,
it returns dx_j=sum_i W_ij*g_i, dW_ij=g_i*x_j and db_i=g_i. A zero derivative at
an exactly zero affine value is a chosen convention; ordinary mathematical
differentiation requires every relevant affine value to be nonzero.

passage.quote:
theorem forward_coordinate (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n))
    (b : Tensor ℝ (column m)) (row : Fin m) :
    Spec.get2 ((graph m n).forward (inputs x w b)) row 0 =
      max ((∑ j : Fin n, Spec.get2 w row j * Spec.get2 x j 0) + Spec.get2 b row 0) 0 :=

theorem checked_result (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n)) (b d : Tensor ℝ (column m)) :
    (graph m n).vjpChecked (inputs x w b) () d =
      .ok (sensitivities x w b d, vecToTensor (vecOfFun fun i => max (tensorToVec (affine x w b) i) 0)) :=

theorem sensitivities_adjoint (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n))
    (b d : Tensor ℝ (column m)) (away : ∀ i, tensorToVec (affine x w b) i ≠ 0) :
    flattenCtx (sensitivities x w b d) =
      (fderiv ℝ (fun v => tensorToVec ((graph m n).forward (unflattenCtx v)))
        (flattenCtx (inputs x w b))).adjoint (tensorToVec d) :=

      |max i.affine 0-max i.idealAffine 0| ≤ i.error :=

    (seed : finiteReal d = some dh) (seedError : |dh-dIdeal| ≤ ed)
